decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cutting and creasing extension with low carrying cost, it remains worth keeping in the portfolio even after two years because the downside of waiting is limited and its fit with existing customer workflows is clear.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the established postpress range, so the firm should keep this low-cost option open while demand in integrated automated workflows continues to develop.
The B2 multifinisher is both strategically important and tightly aligned with the firm's move toward automated digital finishing, making early withdrawal unlikely under real-options logic.

Although its market potential is still less proven than the stronger core launches, the folding add-on unit is a relatively inexpensive complementary option tied to the installed base and therefore should remain on the market for now.
